Where this amendment names a clause under SUPERSEDED_CLAUSES, that clause is superseded ONLY in the respect stated and every other word of it continues to control. Where it names a clause under QUALIFIED_CLAUSES_NOT_SUPERSEDED, the clause controls in full and this amendment records only how it is read alongside the re-staging.

Proves that the stage ladder, every other gate, and the cumulative gate sets of PRODUCTION_READY and GO_LIVE are unchanged.

GATE_RESTAGING.reason: PV3 is the payment-provider configuration gate. Under PILOT-BILLING-01 the payment provider is deliberately OFF through PILOT_READY (RSC-1, RSC-5), so no Pilot-stage SHA has a payment provider to configure, and its criterion ('the capability packages are applied to the target, and a replay and duplicate-delivery test passes in Preview') is satisfiable only after CB-5, which the Pilot defers. Placed at the earliest EXISTING stage after PILOT_READY; mandatory earlier only at a first operational enablement of the payment provider (EPR-1), never by test-mode preparation.

SEC7 depends on PV3 and asserts integrity of a billing webhook that is disabled (CAP-03 off) throughout the Pilot; it cannot be required earlier than the gate it depends on without making the stage order unsatisfiable. Same placement and the same EPR precedence as PV3.

PLACEMENT_DERIVATION.rule_applied: Owner direction RSC-6: if a concrete first_required_at_stage is needed, take the earliest EXISTING post-PILOT_READY stage that preserves the full commercial/production invariant.

candidates.PRODUCTION_READY: ordinal 6, the first stage after PILOT_READY (ordinal 5). Production deployment is authorized there (HPO-G.8). Placing PV3 and SEC7 here keeps the cumulative gate set of PRODUCTION_READY IDENTICAL to the pre-amendment set, so no production authorization can be issued without them.
candidates.GO_LIVE: REJECTED. It would let PRODUCTION_READY authorize production deployment without payment-provider proof, which changes the PRODUCTION_READY gate set and weakens HPO-G.8.

PLACEMENT_DERIVATION.dependency_consistency: PV3 depends on S5 (STAGING_ALIGNED, ordinal 2 <= 6). SEC7 depends on PV3 (both ordinal 6). No gate first required at ordinal <= 5 depends on PV3 or SEC7: the only dependent of PV3 is SEC7, and SEC7 has no dependent (measured over every GATES[].dependencies). The ledger self_check property no_gate_depends_on_a_gate_first_required_at_a_later_stage therefore still holds.

PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.owner_source: RSC-5 ('Stripe-specific provider gates are deferred WHEN Stripe is deliberately OFF'), whose EPR semantic the Product Owner adjudicated in the directing text of CV1-PILOT-BILLING-MINIMUM-AUTHORITY-R3 (2026-09-26, items 1-12, transcribed in substance in owner_adjudication_r3 below). No new owner artifact and no RSC id is created: the adjudication fixes the reading of RSC-5 that this block already materializes.
owner_adjudication_r3: EPR is an ACTIVATION/EXPOSURE invariant, not a prohibition on preparatory evidence-generation activity.

A payment provider is not operationally enabled merely because bounded test-mode preparation is performed to obtain PV3/SEC7 evidence; preparation includes only the minimum actions the frozen PV3/SEC7 criteria require, while the payment path stays unavailable to product, runtime and customer use.
During preparation CAP-03 remains unavailable, no customer-facing payment journey is available, no real payment traffic is accepted, and the provider remains operationally dark.

The FIRST governed declaration that represents the provider as operationally enabled, exposed or usable carries PV3 = PASS and SEC7 = PASS in that same declaration; no governed state may represent it enabled while either is not PASS.
Missing, unknown, stale or contradictory evidence fails closed.

Through PILOT_READY under ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE, PAYMENT_PROVIDER_DARK remains required; PV3 and SEC7 stay first_required_at_stage PRODUCTION_READY while the provider stays dark, and become mandatory at an earlier operational-enablement boundary if there is one.
Nothing here waives PV3 or SEC7, marks either PASS, creates a stage or a gate, weakens Commercial Core or permits CAP-03 in the no-Stripe Pilot.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.single_semantic: EPR has exactly ONE semantic, stated in rule and defined by preparatory_activity and operational_enablement_means_any_of. Every restatement in this file, in the consuming authority and in the companion manifest paraphrases it and neither adds nor removes a condition; a restatement that does is a defect of the restatement.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.rule: EPR-1 OPERATIONAL ENABLEMENT REQUIRES PASS: at no SHA and target may the payment provider be operationally enabled (any member of operational_enablement_means_any_of) while PV3 or SEC7 is not PASS for that SHA and target, and the first governed act or declaration that makes or represents the provider operationally enabled MUST cite, in that same act or declaration, PASS evidence for PV3 and for SEC7 bound to that SHA and target. If that boundary precedes PRODUCTION_READY, PV3 and SEC7 are mandatory from it onward. EPR-2 DARK BELOW PRODUCTION_READY DOES NOT BLOCK: while the provider remains operationally dark, a declaration below PRODUCTION_READY does not require PV3 or SEC7, which keep their recorded non-PASS states without blocking the no-Stripe Pilot. EPR-3 PRODUCTION_READY: PV3 and SEC7 are mandatory at PRODUCTION_READY regardless (RS-1, RS-2). Preparatory activity is NOT operational enablement. Neither gate may be regressed after it has been required. PASS means the ledger STATE_VOCABULARY value PASS ('Evidence was executed and is current under RULE_OBSERVATION_FRESHNESS'); PASS_OVER_STALE_INPUT, PARTIAL, ABSENT, UNKNOWN or any other value is not PASS.

preparatory_activity.definition: The actions strictly necessary to produce the evidence named by the FROZEN pass_criteria of PV3 and SEC7, performed in the payment provider's TEST MODE (PV3 is 'payment provider in test mode') while every member of operational_enablement_means_any_of is false. Bounded to PREP-1..PREP-4 and to nothing else. Preparatory activity is neither required nor forbidden by EPR; it is merely not enablement.

bounded_to.admitted_as: test-mode payment-provider credential NAMES in the Preview scope of the target (names only, SSL-08). A live-mode credential is never preparation (OE-1).

bounded_to.criterion_conjunct: PV3: 'the webhook endpoint and signing secret are configured'
bounded_to.admitted_as: a test-mode webhook endpoint and its test-mode signing secret configured for the Preview scope.

bounded_to.criterion_conjunct: PV3 and SEC7: 'the capability packages are applied to the target'
bounded_to.admitted_as: the billing capability database packages applied to the target, with no product-serving runtime path wired to them (wiring is OE-5).

bounded_to.criterion_conjunct: PV3: 'a replay and duplicate-delivery test passes in Preview'; SEC7: 'Signature verification, claim and lease semantics and duplicate handling are green, an out-of-order delivery is either guarded or explicitly accepted'
bounded_to.admitted_as: the replay, duplicate-delivery, signature, claim/lease and ordering tests executed in the Preview scope with test-mode events only, in a deployment that serves no product or runtime traffic.

conditions_while_preparing: CAP-03 remains unavailable to every product-serving deployment.
No customer-facing payment journey is reachable.
No live-mode payment event is accepted and no real payment traffic flows.
The provider remains operationally dark: a PAYMENT_PROVIDER_DARK attestation over operational_enablement_means_any_of stays true throughout.
preparatory_activity.anti_loophole: Anything beyond PREP-1..PREP-4, any PREP item performed while a member of operational_enablement_means_any_of holds, any use of a live-mode credential or live-mode event, and any PREP item reachable from a product-serving deployment, is NOT preparatory activity: it is operational enablement, whatever it is called.

operational_enablement_means_any_of: OE-1 a LIVE-MODE (non-test) payment-provider credential NAME present in any environment scope of the target (names only; SSL-08).

OE-2 the billing webhook capability CAP-03 switched on in any deployment that serves product or runtime traffic of the target, including app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts WEBHOOK_DATABASE_IDENTITY_AVAILABLE true at a SHA deployed to a product-serving scope.
OE-3 any customer-facing payment journey, or any path that creates a payment-provider customer, checkout session or subscription, reachable from a product-serving deployment.
OE-4 any live-mode payment event accepted by any deployment of the target, or any real payment traffic.

OE-5 any Stripe-dependent node of the commercial authorities (CB-3, CB-4, CB-5, CB-6, CB-9, CE-6) wired into a runtime path of a product-serving deployment. Applying such a node's database package is PREP-3, not OE-5.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.product_serving_scope: Any environment scope or deployment from which pilot participants, customers or any other real user are served, the Production scope included. A Preview deployment used only for PREP-4 with test-mode events and reached by no real user is not product-serving.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.declaration_requirement: Every declaration of FEATURE_COMPLETE_STAGING, RELEASE_CANDIDATE or PILOT_READY cites, alongside its gate evidence, a PAYMENT_PROVIDER_DARK attestation of the ledger's existing evidence class PROVIDER_DARK_PROOF (a fresh observation of the live environment scope; a repository default, a committed configuration or a documented value is not an observation) bound to the declared SHA and target under EVIDENCE_IDENTITY_RULE: no member of operational_enablement_means_any_of holds. Preparatory activity already performed may be listed and does not defeat the attestation. A declaration below PRODUCTION_READY that cannot attest the provider dark MUST instead cite PASS evidence for PV3 and SEC7 bound to the same SHA and target (EPR-1); with neither, it is not a declaration (declaration_rule of the companion authority). Every PRODUCTION_READY and GO_LIVE declaration cites PV3 and SEC7 PASS regardless (EPR-3). This is an additional requirement, never a substitute for any gate.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.fail_closed: Missing, UNKNOWN, stale (not current under RULE_OBSERVATION_FRESHNESS, not bound to the declared SHA and target under EVIDENCE_IDENTITY_RULE, or recorded PASS_OVER_STALE_INPUT) or contradictory evidence counts as NOT DARK for the attestation and NOT PASS for PV3 and SEC7. A provider whose state cannot be established is treated as operationally enabled without PASS, and the act or declaration fails.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.why_not_a_gate: No gate id is allocated. The attestation is a declaration-content condition attached to an existing rule, so the ledger's closed gate list and its 78-gate count are unchanged.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.why_no_new_vocabulary: Every term is existing authority: 'test mode' (PV3 name), 'Preview scope' (companion CANONICAL_STAGES ordinal 3 required_environment_evidence), PROVIDER_DARK_PROOF (ledger evidence class of S7 and S10), STATE_VOCABULARY PASS and RULE_OBSERVATION_FRESHNESS, EVIDENCE_IDENTITY_RULE, CAP-03 and SSL-08. No enum, state machine, stage or gate is created.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.reachability_proof: No circularity: every conjunct of the PV3 and SEC7 pass_criteria is one of PREP-1..PREP-4, and no PREP item is a member of operational_enablement_means_any_of, so PV3 and then SEC7 (which depends on PV3) can reach PASS on a target that is still operationally dark. The full commercial route is therefore: dark target -> PREP-1..PREP-4 -> PV3 PASS -> SEC7 PASS -> the first operational-enablement act cites both PASS in that same act (EPR-1) -> PRODUCTION_READY cites both PASS (EPR-3). The provider may equally stay dark through PRODUCTION_READY. Both routes reach PRODUCTION_READY.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.consequence_for_the_pilot: Under ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE no member of operational_enablement_means_any_of holds by construction of the consuming authority (PBR-9, PB-N-22; CAP-03 FORBIDDEN IN PILOT). Every declaration through PILOT_READY carries the PAYMENT_PROVIDER_DARK attestation, and the Pilot path requires neither PV3 nor SEC7 (EPR-2). Preparatory activity for the later commercial route is never a Pilot act (the consuming authority's anti_pull_in_rule) and never makes the provider operationally enabled.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ENABLEMENT_PRECEDENCE.consequence_for_the_full_commercial_rout: Full Stripe automation (COMMERCIAL_CORE_USABLE of the commercial authorities) eventually enables the provider operationally. PV3 and SEC7 evidence is produced while the target is still dark through PREP-1..PREP-4; the first act or declaration that makes the provider operationally enabled, such as CAP-03 enablement, cites PV3 PASS and SEC7 PASS in that same act or declaration (EPR-1); PRODUCTION_READY cites both regardless (EPR-3). Billing OF-4 (CAP-03 MUST NOT be enabled before CB-5) is untouched and composes with EPR: CB-5's database packages are PREP-3, its runtime enablement is OE-2 and OE-5.

HPO_G_DISPOSITION.rule: HPO-G text is NOT amended and NOT reopened. The owner's own reading of HPO-G.6 and HPO-G.7 (RSC-5, recorded in the binding owner ratification) is materialized here.
HPO_G_DISPOSITION.HPO-G.5: UNCHANGED. STAGING_ALIGNED still requires parity with provider capabilities dark (S7, S10). The payment provider stays dark for longer, which is compatible with and stricter than G.5.
HPO_G_DISPOSITION.HPO-G.6: SCOPE-AWARE. 'Then browser/provider gates' is read as: every browser journey gate (M9, J1, J2, J3, J4, G13) and every provider gate APPLICABLE TO THE RELEASE CONFIGURATION (PV1, PV2, PV5, PV6; PV4 stays at RELEASE_CANDIDATE as before) is required at FEATURE_COMPLETE_STAGING, before RELEASE_CANDIDATE. The payment-provider gates PV3 and SEC7 are applicable only to a configuration in which the payment provider is enabled; with the provider deliberately OFF they are deferred to PRODUCTION_READY; under EPR they become mandatory earlier only at the first OPERATIONAL enablement of the provider, and bounded test-mode preparation for their evidence does not pull them forward.
HPO_G_DISPOSITION.HPO-G.7: UNCHANGED. RELEASE_CANDIDATE may not be entered before FEATURE_COMPLETE_STAGING is declared at the same SHA; no RELEASE_CANDIDATE gate is added, removed or moved.
HPO_G_DISPOSITION.HPO-G.8: UNCHANGED AND CARRIED. Production still requires recovery evidence, observability, security and legal signoff and normal lineage; the PRODUCTION_READY new-gate list gains PV3 and SEC7, and its cumulative set is unchanged.

NON_REGRESSION_RULE_DISPOSITION: UNCHANGED AND APPLIED. Each gate is still listed once, at its earliest required stage, and inherited by every later stage. After this amendment PV3 and SEC7 are listed at PRODUCTION_READY and inherited by GO_LIVE; per-stage sets remain DERIVED from first_required_at_stage (read through GATE_RESTAGING) and are never restated.

DERIVED_STAGE_SETS.method: cumulative set of stage N = every GATES[].id whose first_required_at_stage (after GATE_RESTAGING) has ordinal <= N; ledger gate count 78.

PILOT_READY_REACHABILITY.claim: FORMALLY REACHABLE WITHOUT STRIPE under ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE: the ladder DEVELOPMENT_COMPLETE -> STAGING_ALIGNED -> FEATURE_COMPLETE_STAGING -> RELEASE_CANDIDATE -> PILOT_READY contains no gate that requires the payment provider, CB-5 or CAP-03.
PILOT_READY_REACHABILITY.basis: The derived PILOT_READY set (60 gates) excludes exactly PV3 and SEC7. A whole-ledger search of every gate's name, pass_criteria and source_of_truth for stripe, payment, billing and webhook matches only PV3 and SEC7 (the word 'checkout' additionally occurs in M1 and M8, where it is the git/CI checkout step, not a payment checkout). The LC0 baseline gates commercial_activation on legal instruments (HTF-11), not on payment (docs/ops/compliance/LC0_CANONICAL_REGULATORY_DATA_GOVERNANCE_BASELINE_v1.0.0.json), and LC0-PILOT's criterion is unchanged.
PILOT_READY_REACHABILITY.what_reachable_does_not_mean: Reachable is a structural property: no gate on the path is unsatisfiable BECAUSE the provider is off. Every other gate on the path must still be satisfied with evidence at the declared SHA; none is satisfied, accepted or narrowed here.
